items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you know what song is called the Patoua, Gombau?

ctx.x: You see, when it's all, everything goes. And otherwise, I'm here, I'm here in the day, I sing with him all the songs I had used to sing when I was young. Now I can't remember anything.
Do you know what song is called the Patoua, Gombau?
